title: How does the system protect people 60+?
body:
How does the system protect people 60+?

For grandparents we made special protection:

• We block calls from scammers (they often target people 60+)
• We check sites before they open
• A simple interface—clear even if you are not used to smartphones
• Voice control (say “call my grandson” and the call starts)
• Red SOS—get help quickly
